summary: Enhance your leadership skills with this Leading with Integrity and Ethics Course. Learn how to lead with integrity and make ethical decisions effectively.
lede: Leadership ethics training helps managers and ethics, compliance, HR, risk, audit, and governance professionals put integrity expectations into daily practice. It covers applying ethical decision models, assessing conduct risks, and designing codes of conduct, escalation paths, and whistleblowing triage workflows. Participants also learn to track ethics indicators and use dashboards and reporting workflows to support oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you hold a leadership, management, ethics, compliance, HR, risk, audit, or governance role and need to turn integrity and ethics expectations into clear decisions, workflows, and measurable outcomes across your teams. This course is designed for: Team Leader responsible for daily behaviour standards and conduct risk on their unit. Department Manager overseeing code of conduct compliance and performance incentives. Ethics and Compliance Manager designing policies, ISO 37301 processes, and training. HR Business Partner handling investigations, disciplinary governance, and culture initiatives. Internal Auditor evaluating COSO Internal Control effectiveness for ethics-related risks. Risk Manager monitoring conduct risk indicators and escalation pathways across functions. Legal Counsel advising on whistleblowing procedures, retaliation, and investigation protocols. Operations Manager balancing productivity demands with safe, ethical working practices. Governance or Secretariat Officer preparing ethics reports for boards and committees. Learning and Development Specialist integrating ethics tools into leadership programs.
modules: Foundations of Integrity and Ethics in Leadership
Codes of Conduct and Ethical Culture Design
Ethics Measurement, Conduct Risk, and Digital Reporting
Leading Through Ethics Crises and Investigations
Embedding Ethics into Team Management and Operations
Strategic Ethics Roadmap and Leadership Reporting
prerequisites: You should currently work in a role involving leadership, management, HR, risk, audit, compliance, or governance responsibilities, with basic familiarity with your organization’s policies and code of conduct. No legal expertise or coding/programming skills are necessary, though comfort working with spreadsheets or simple dashboard tools will help you engage more fully in ethics KPI and conduct risk exercises. To maximize value, review your current ethics policies, escalation procedures, and any recent conduct cases before attending, as these can be used as input for course exercises subject to confidentiality constraints.
